about_the_game:
Grow your dream orchard by shaking trees for a burst of delicious fruits, or upgrade to let your orchard run on autopilot!

KEY FEATURES

  • Meet: Co! Co is an upbeat and curious adventurer. With a friendly smile and a can-do attitude, Co embodies enthusiasm for nurturing each tiny sprout into a flourishing tree.

  • Hands-On Tree Shaking
    Give each tree a good shake to make fruits tumble to the ground, offering a satisfying, interactive way to harvest.

  • Upgrade to Idle
    Prefer a hands-off approach? Invest in powerful orchard upgrades that automate tasks. Earn coins and watch your orchard thrive, even when you’re not actively playing.

  • Sapling Buying & Planting
    Buy unique saplings, drop them where you want them to grow, and watch as tiny saplings become fruit-bearing trees. Expand your orchard any way you like!

  • Earn & Reinvent
    Sell your harvested fruit for coins, then pour your profits into faster-growing trees, better shakes, or idle boosters to supercharge your orchard’s output.

  • Relaxing 2D Aesthetic
    Enjoy a cheerful, pixel art style where bright colors and gentle animations create a laid-back environment—perfect for active or idle playstyles alike.

PLAY YOUR WAY

  • Active Approach: Jump in, shake and harvest every fruit manually.

  • Idle Clicker: Collect upgrades, automate orchard tasks, and let the harvest come to you.

Whether you want to shake each tree yourself or let your orchard run on autopilot, Shake it Co! offers a customizable and relaxing fruit-farming experience. Grab your saplings, earn those coins, and grow the orchard of your dreams!
